title: Construct the lifted algebra and adjoint algebra maps
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated and finite type. Write $X_n=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I^{n+1})$ and $j_n:X_n\to X$. Let $i_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$ be the canonical transition immersion, specified by both pullback projection equations. Let $c_n:i_n^*j_{n+1}^*\cong j_n^*$ be the canonical composition comparison of tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $p_n:Y_n\to X_n$ be finite, with $g_n:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$ giving cartesian transition squares and $j_{n+1}\circ p_{n+1}\circ g_n=j_n\circ p_n$. Let $G$ be a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent] on $X$ with support proper over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and suppose isomorphisms $\psi_n:j_n^*G\cong p_{n,*}\mathcal O_{Y_n}$ commute with $c_n$ and the canonical affine base-change maps followed by the structure-sheaf pullback maps [lem-weil-pbc-affine-pushforward-base-change]. Then there exist an algebra sheaf B [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], an explicit underlying-module isomorphism e:B.toModule ≅ G, and algebra maps b_n:B -> (j_n p_n)_* O_Yn. On each open U and each x in B(U), b_n(U)(x) is the composite of the tensor-pullback adjunction unit at B.toModule, j_n^*(e.hom), psi_n.hom, and the canonical pushforward-composition comparison.  The comparison is the explicit mate tensorPullbackCompositionIso [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], built from the pinned adjunctions. No transition equality of the b_n is asserted.

proof.text: Apply finite_structure_multiplication_lift to obtain the uniquely determined multiplication mu, its associative and commutative section laws and multiplicativity under each finiteStructureAdjoint. Apply finite_structure_unit_lift to mu and its symmetry and multiplicativity to obtain the unique unit eta, its left-unit law and the structure-map formula for its adjoints.

Define a commutative ring on each section group of G: xy=mu(x tensor y) and 1=eta(1). The associativity, symmetry and left-unit equations provide the multiplicative laws. Tensor bilinearity and module-map additivity provide both distributive and zero laws. Naturality makes restriction a ring homomorphism. The underlying type-valued presheaf is a sheaf because the additive presheaf of G is; reflection by the ring forgetful functor gives the ring sheaf condition. The scalar map is eta(r)=r eta(1), which is multiplicative by bilinearity and the left-unit law. This gives B. Identity on each section group is an isomorphism e:B.toModule to G, since scalar multiplication through this structure map is the original scalar multiplication. Each adjoint is a ring homomorphism by the two lifted operation formulas, and these ring homomorphisms are natural and commute with the scalar maps. They give the maps b_n.

For the exact section formula, expand finiteStructureAdjoint. The adjunction unit is natural in e.hom, so precomposing its adjoint by e.hom is the adjoint of tensorPullback.map e.hom followed by psi.hom. Functoriality of pushforward and associativity of composition prove this equality in Lean. Evaluate it on U and x; it is precisely the requested formula.
